releaseNotesMarkdown:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mveinot/transmission-control/compare/v2.5.0.447...v2.5.2.455

Bugfix and minor feature release:

* Save and restore window size on exit and app start
* Honour standard macOS CMD+M shortcut for minimize
* When closed to tray icon, left click on tray icon restores app
* Fix error that can occur when trying to set Planetary as the default app for torrent files when the previous default app is no longer installed
